page.overview:
What is Dekanuchan?

Compared to her previous form, Tinkaton's hair is now larger to the point that it nearly reaches the ground. While she still remains predominantly pink, her arms are now white sans her thumb, which is the same pink as her body. What makes her stand out even more compared to Tinkatuff is that the hammer it uses is now outrageously larger compared to herself.

Despite their cute appearances, Tinkaton have an intelligent but also daring and even cruel disposition. They enjoy hurting and hunting -type Pokémon, simply by swinging their hammer, and plunder whatever loot as they please back to their home. A Tinkaton usually leads the Tinkatink and Tinkatuff in its group to teach them skills on how to pound and shape metal.

Tinkaton is Corviknight's natural predator as it likes to use its massive hammer to launch rocks at flying Corviknight to knock them out of the sky. Therefore, Flying Taxi operators in Paldea to use Squawkabilly instead of Corviknight to avoid dangers and endangering the customers caused by Tinkaton.

Tinkaton also has been seen to sleep on their hammers like a bed. If anyone tries to take or touch its hammer, it will react hostilely.
